description: 5 should-trigger + 5 should-not-trigger. Should-trigger covers the bounded keep-or-revert loop against a SCALAR metric (direction, no destination). Should-not-trigger covers the near-miss neighbours the roadmap's gap-table names: iterate-to-a-known-end-state (verify-repair-loop), subjective craft with no scalar, a one-shot measurement, a one-shot review, and asking what a metric currently is.

queries.q: minimize the bundle size, keep changes that help and revert the rest
optimize this until it stops improving, bounded to ten tries
drive the query count down across iterations and record what you kept
run a keep-or-revert loop against the lint violation count
reduce this metric as far as it goes without breaking the tests
keep fixing until the tests pass
queries.note: a known end state, not a direction → verify-repair-loop

queries.q: iterate this change to green, run the suite each time
is this diff clean — naming, structure, conventions?
queries.note: subjective craft, no scalar to optimize

queries.q: how big is the bundle right now?
review my changes before I open the PR
